purpose: A numeric field that reads and writes numbers the way the locale does, with a stepper, clamping and currency formatting.
$operationsNote: Mirrors shared/core/agent/field.ts, which is what the runtime dispatches on. source/components/shared/core/agent/__tests__/field-passport.test.ts fails if the two drift. No `apiMethod`: a field is written through its ref — the element for most of these, a handle for Combobox and DatePicker — and that is a normal case, not a gap. Inside an <AgentSurface> the component registers itself with these operations; NumberInput and RadioGroup are then written through their own commit path rather than the element.

setValue.summary: Write a value into the field, as though a person had entered it.

focus.summary: Move keyboard focus to the field.

supplied: role=spinbutton semantics with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax
ArrowUp and ArrowDown step; PageUp and PageDown use `largeStep`
the stepper buttons are aria-hidden, because the keyboard already does what they do
description and error linked by aria-describedby
required: a `label`, or `aria-label` when the field is visually unlabelled
`min` and `max` where a range exists, so assistive technology can announce it

composition.notes: Renders its own label and input.

safeMutations.rationale: Everything that defines the number — its bounds, its precision, its currency, how it snaps — is domain truth, not styling. Changing `decimals` or `currency` silently reinterprets a stored value.

propNotes.clampBehavior: Decides whether an out-of-range entry is corrected as it is typed or left for validation. Changing it changes what the user is allowed to leave in the field.
propNotes.wheel: Scroll-to-change is off by default because it fires while a page is being scrolled past.
